title: Disappointed to the max!
text: Disappointed to the max!. Ordered this...and got something totally different! The worst part was the item they sent was broken beyond repair! So I didn't get my order...and what junk I did get was broken! DO NOT BUY from this place... If you like junk ...broken junk ...than this is the place to get it! Very, very unhappy!!
